components.name: Twitch Cannon
components.blurb: Fires faster than it should and breaks sooner than it should. Fenn fix it between shots and call that a feature.
components.quirk: An auto turret that fires every 0.6 s, but it malfunctions 20% a minute: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Spark Lattice
components.blurb: Every hit throws sparks into the neighbours. A Fenn engineer calls it free damage, then checks the wiring.
components.quirk: Splinters hit 3 cells beside the impact, but the turret takes 0.1 hp a second while it runs: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Market Missile
components.blurb: Cheap enough to fire on credit. One in four is a dud, and it comes with a receipt.
components.quirk: Fires scrap for ammunition and flies fast and agile, but a quarter of the missiles are duds: its damage already counts them (5 x 0.75).

components.name: Haggle Engine
components.blurb: Thrust bought at a discount. The seller said it was practically new, and left quickly.
components.quirk: Thrust 23 (x1.3 over a Mk2), but it malfunctions 20% a minute: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Jury Reactor
components.blurb: Held together with a good argument. Two more power than it has any business making, and it stops when it feels slighted.
components.quirk: +2 power over a Reactor Mk1, but it malfunctions 15% a minute: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Quickfix Bay
components.blurb: A cart of tools, a rack of spares and a sign that says back in a minute. Repairs go twice as fast in here.
components.quirk: Crew in its room repair, patch and put fires out twice as fast, but the bay draws 2 power.
